_comment: Copy this file to cards.config.json and edit locally. Key = LAST 4 DIGITS of the card number. name = display name. mm = cycle anchor month (01-12, the month the accumulation cycle resets). Optional reserved key _default.mm = fallback applied automatically to any newly-detected card that has no month yet (e.g. '12' = December); existing entries are never overwritten. A legacy 'mmdd' value still works (the build reads its leading MM). cards.config.json is git-ignored so real card numbers never reach the repo. You can also set entries with the /set-expiryCard command, and list every card with /list-cards.
